title: Sentinel Managed Security Accounts Receivable Policy: Due Dates, Payments, Late Fees and Suspension
content:
The amount a client owes on its Sentinel Managed Security subscription rises with each charge and falls with each payment and service credit. The following provisions govern that balance.

## Due dates

Invoices fall due the tier's payment-terms number of calendar days after posting. For a hypothetical invoice posted on 1 May under net 30 terms, the due date is 31 May.

## Applying payments

A payment is applied to the invoice its remittance names, otherwise to the oldest open invoice first, one entry per invoice applied. A remittance reference is applied to a given invoice only once: an entry already recorded for the same remittance reference on the same invoice means that remittance is not applied to that invoice again.

Illustration (hypothetical amounts): a remittance of 1500.00 USD that names no invoice, received while invoice A (the oldest, 1000.00 USD open) and invoice B (800.00 USD open) are outstanding, is applied as 1000.00 USD to invoice A and 500.00 USD to invoice B, two entries.

## Late fees

On the first day of each calendar month, every invoice still unpaid more than the tier's grace period in calendar days after its due date is assessed one late fee of the tier's monthly late fee percentage of its unpaid balance, rounded half up to the cent.

| Hypothetical grace period of 7 days | Calendar days from due date to 1 June | Late fee on 1 June? |
|---|---|---|
| Due 25 May | 7 | No (not more than 7) |
| Due 24 May | 8 | Yes |

An invoice with a hypothetical unpaid balance of 800.00 USD, assessed at 1.5 percent, carries a late fee of 12.00 USD for that month. One late fee is assessed per invoice for each month assessed.

## Suspension and reinstatement

SOC monitoring may be suspended once the oldest unpaid invoice is the tier's suspension threshold of days past due. During suspension the endpoint agents keep enforcing local protection, and the monthly fee continues. Monitoring is reinstated once every past-due invoice is paid in full, without a reinstatement fee; the subscription then returns from suspended to active.

## Termination for non-payment

A subscription suspended for the tier's termination threshold of days may be terminated for non-payment, and it then closes.
